us-company.zh: 美国公司（LLC 或股份公司）

software.zh: 一次性售卖的软件（授权、下载）

ai-app.en: an AI app or tool (chat, writing, agents)
ai-app.zh: AI 应用或工具（对话、写作、智能体）

ebook.zh: 电子书和 PDF 指南

service.en: a service a person delivers (consulting, coaching, agency work)
service.zh: 真人提供的服务（咨询、教练、代做）

advice.en: No registered company: open as an individual. Creem, Dodo Payments and Waffo Pancake take individuals in mainland China.
advice.zh: 没注册公司，就用个人开。Creem、Dodo Payments、Waffo Pancake 都接受中国大陆个人。

advice.en: Dodo's line between the two: an individual is a creator or sole proprietor paid personally, with no company registration or business tax ID; a registered entity has a tax ID and is paid to the company's bank account.
advice.zh: Dodo 给的分法：个人是创作者或个体经营，钱进你本人的账户，没有公司注册和税号；注册实体有税号，钱进公司的对公账户。

advice.en: Creem pays a mainland individual to Alipay: up to CNY 50,000 a payout and CNY 300,000–600,000 a year. Past that, a company's bank account.
advice.zh: Creem 给大陆个人打款到支付宝：单笔最多 5 万元，每年 30–60 万元。超过这个量，要用公司的对公账户。

advice.en: Stripe opens for neither individuals nor companies in mainland China: it takes a Hong Kong or US company. Polar pays out only through Stripe, so the same holds.
advice.zh: Stripe 不给中国大陆个人或公司开户，要香港或美国公司；Polar 只能通过 Stripe 出款，也一样。

advice.en: Switching later from individual to company means a business verification and a new bank check (Dodo), so pick the one you will keep.
advice.zh: 以后从个人改成公司，要补公司验证、重新验证银行账户（Dodo 如此），所以按你打算长期用的身份选。

advice.en: How the income is taxed at home is a question for an accountant: this guide covers what the platforms ask for, not tax.
advice.zh: 收入在国内怎么报税，请问会计：这里只写平台的要求，不涉及税务。

fee.en: US account: 2.9% + 30¢, international cards +1.5%, currency conversion +1%. Hong Kong: 3.4% + HK$2.35, international +0.5%, conversion +2%. Subscriptions through Stripe Billing +0.7%.
fee.zh: 美国账户 2.9% + 30 美分，国际卡 +1.5%，换汇 +1%；香港账户 3.4% + 2.35 港元，国际卡 +0.5%，换汇 +2%；用 Stripe Billing 收订阅另加 0.7%。

payout.en: to a bank account in the account's country (not a virtual account)
payout.zh: 打到账户所在国的银行账户（不接受虚拟账户）

review_time.en: activation after the website and business details check out
review_time.zh: 网站和公司信息核实后激活

chargebacks.en: card networks treat 0.7% as excessive; Stripe can hold a reserve when disputes rise
chargebacks.zh: 卡组织把 0.7% 视为过高；拒付变多时 Stripe 可能冻结一部分款项

en: Not a Merchant of Record: you handle sales tax and VAT yourself, or add Managed Payments (Stripe as MoR, +3.5%, for fully automated digital products; open to businesses in the US, Canada, 31 European countries, Australia, Hong Kong, Japan and Singapore).
zh: 不是 MoR：销售税和增值税要你自己报，或者开 Managed Payments（Stripe 代收税，每笔多收 3.5%，只卖全自动交付的数字产品；面向美国、加拿大、31 个欧洲国家、澳大利亚、香港、日本和新加坡的商家）。

note.en: no accounts for mainland China; open with a Hong Kong or US company instead
note.zh: 不支持中国大陆，要用香港或美国公司开

note.en: a local bank account and address are needed
note.zh: 需要香港本地银行账户和地址

note.en: a US bank account and mailing address; a non-US owner without SSN gives a local tax ID
note.zh: 需要美国银行账户和通信地址；没有 SSN 的非美国负责人提供本国税号

payout.en: monthly by wire or Payoneer, minimum US$100; CNY by bank wire
payout.zh: 每月一次，电汇或 Payoneer，最低 100 美元；可以人民币电汇

review_time.en: most checkout domains are approved automatically; a manual review takes 5–7 business days
review_time.zh: 大多数结账域名自动通过；人工审核要 5–7 个工作日

chargebacks.en: keep chargebacks under 0.65% of volume; US$20 per chargeback
chargebacks.zh: 拒付要低于交易额的 0.65%；每笔拒付收 20 美元

en: Identity is checked through Sumsub (ID, proof of address, sometimes a selfie).
zh: 身份通过 Sumsub 核验（证件、地址证明，有时要自拍）。

note.en: China is not on the blocked list, sole traders can sign up and payouts can be made in CNY; Paddle does not say it in as many words
note.zh: 中国不在封禁名单上，个体户可以注册，可以人民币出款；但官方没有明说接受

note.en: as for individuals; a business verification step follows
note.zh: 同个人；之后还有公司验证

payout.en: twice a month in USD after a 13-day hold, minimum US$50 (bank or PayPal)
payout.zh: 每月两次，美元，押款 13 天，最低 50 美元（银行或 PayPal）

chargebacks.en: too many chargebacks can suspend the account; US$15 per dispute
chargebacks.zh: 拒付太多会被停用；每笔争议收 15 美元

en: Owned by Stripe; in January 2026 its CEO said the team is building toward Stripe Managed Payments and that support has slowed (https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/blog/2026-update).
zh: 已被 Stripe 收购；2026 年 1 月 CEO 公开说团队在转向 Stripe Managed Payments，支持变慢了（https://www.lemonsqueezy.com/blog/2026-update）。

note.en: payouts reach mainland China only through PayPal; signing up from mainland China is not stated
note.zh: 只能通过 PayPal 提现到中国大陆；官方没说中国大陆能不能注册

payout.en: 1st and 15th of the month after a 7–12-day risk hold; fee US$/€7 or 1%, whichever is higher; minimum US$/€50
payout.zh: 每月 1 号和 15 号出款，先押 7–12 天；手续费 7 美元/欧元或 1%，取高者；最低 50 美元/欧元

chargebacks.en: excessive chargebacks can suspend the account; US$/€25 per chargeback
chargebacks.zh: 拒付过多会被停用；每笔拒付收 25 美元/欧元

en: A rejection is final for that store and that business.
Restricted products (services, API resellers, generative AI) need earlier processor history and chargeback and refund rates.
zh: 被拒是终局：这个店铺和这家公司都不能再申请。
受限产品（服务、API 转售、生成式 AI）要提供以往的收款记录、拒付率和退款率。

note.en: payouts to Alipay, up to CNY 50,000 a payout and CNY 300,000–600,000 a year
note.zh: 提现到支付宝，单笔最多 5 万元，每年 30–60 万元

note.en: payouts to a local bank account

steps: Fill in the business details: your full name as an individual, or the company's name.
Verify your identity (KYC).
Add a payout account: Alipay for a mainland individual.
Creem's team reviews the store and the website, in 1–2 working days. A rejection is final for that store and that business, so check the site first.
Live payments are turned on.
needs: an identity document for KYC
an Alipay account in your name
a live website that meets the review checklist

steps: 填业务信息：个人填本人全名，公司填公司名。
做身份验证（KYC）。
添加收款账户：大陆个人用支付宝。
Creem 人工审核店铺和网站，1–2 个工作日。被拒是终局，这个店铺和这家公司都不能再申请，所以先体检网站。
开通正式收款。
needs: 做 KYC 用的身份证件
本人名下的支付宝
一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

steps: Fill in the business details: your full name as an individual, or the company's name.
Verify your identity (KYC) and the company (KYB).
Add a payout account: the company's bank account.
Creem's team reviews the store and the website, in 1–2 working days. A rejection is final for that store and that business, so check the site first.
Live payments are turned on.
needs: the company's registration documents for KYB
the company's bank account
a live website that meets the review checklist

steps: 填业务信息：个人填本人全名，公司填公司名。
做身份验证（KYC）和公司验证（KYB）。
添加收款账户：公司的对公银行账户。
Creem 人工审核店铺和网站，1–2 个工作日。被拒是终局，这个店铺和这家公司都不能再申请，所以先体检网站。
开通正式收款。
needs: 做 KYB 用的公司注册文件
公司的对公银行账户
一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

payout.en: SWIFT or local transfer to an account in your own or your company's name, minimum US$50; US$5 under US$1,000; US$25 for USD wires
payout.zh: SWIFT 或本地转账到你本人或公司名下的账户，最低 50 美元；低于 1,000 美元收 5 美元，美元电汇收 25 美元

review_time.zh: 1–3 个工作日；可以申诉一次

chargebacks.en: high refund or dispute rates trigger a review; alerts can refund buyers before a chargeback
chargebacks.zh: 退款或争议率高会触发复审；预警可以在拒付发生前先给买家退款

en: Payouts start only after a separate monitoring review.
zh: 出款前还要单独过一次监控审核。

note.en: China is on the accepted list (from 23 March 2026); ID and selfie through Persona
note.zh: 中国在可接受名单上（2026 年 3 月 23 日起）；证件和自拍通过 Persona 核验

note.en: every director and every owner of 10% or more needs an ID from a listed country
note.zh: 每位董事和持股 10% 以上的股东，都要有名单内国家的证件

steps: Choose the account type: Individual.
Submit the product information.
Verify your identity with a government-issued photo ID and a selfie, through Persona: a few minutes, three attempts.
Add a bank account in the same name as the verified ID; third-party accounts are refused.
The review takes 1–3 business days, with one appeal; payouts start after a separate monitoring review.
needs: a valid, physical photo ID issued by a country on Dodo's accepted list
a phone or webcam for the selfie
a bank account in your own name
a live website that meets the review checklist

steps: 选账户类型：个人（Individual）。
提交产品信息。
用政府签发的带照片证件和自拍做身份验证（Persona）：几分钟，有 3 次机会。
填银行账户：户名必须和验证过的证件一致，不能用别人的账户。
审核 1–3 个工作日，可以申诉一次；第一次出款前还有一轮单独的监控审核。
needs: Dodo 可接受国家签发的有效实体带照片证件
能自拍的手机或摄像头
本人名下的银行账户
一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

steps: Choose the account type: Registered Entity.
Submit the product information.
Verify your identity with a government-issued photo ID and a selfie, through Persona: a few minutes, three attempts.
Business verification (KYB): the company registration number with its certificate of incorporation, and IDs for every director and every owner of 10% or more.
Add the company's bank account, in its legal name.
The review takes 1–3 business days, with one appeal; payouts start after a separate monitoring review.
needs: the company registration number and certificate of incorporation (a tax ID is optional)
IDs for every director and every owner of 10% or more
a bank account in the company's legal name
a live website that meets the review checklist

steps: 选账户类型：注册实体（Registered Entity）。
提交产品信息。
用政府签发的带照片证件和自拍做身份验证（Persona）：几分钟，有 3 次机会。
公司验证（KYB）：公司注册号和注册证书（或当地同等文件），以及每位董事和持股 10% 以上股东的证件。
填公司的银行账户，户名是公司全称。
审核 1–3 个工作日，可以申诉一次；第一次出款前还有一轮单独的监控审核。
needs: 公司注册号和注册证书（税号可选）
每位董事和持股 10% 以上股东的证件
公司名下的银行账户
一个已经上线、符合审核清单的网站

fee.en: new organizations 5% + 50¢ (from 27 May 2026), or monthly plans at 3.4–3.8%; international +1.5%.

payout.en: manual withdrawals, minimum US$10; a 7-day settlement delay for organizations created after 12 May 2026
payout.zh: 手动提现，最低 10 美元；2026 年 5 月 12 日以后建的组织，款项先押 7 天

review_time.en: the first review takes up to 14 days
review_time.zh: 第一次审核最长 14 天

chargebacks.en: keep chargebacks under 0.4%; US$15 per dispute
chargebacks.zh: 拒付要低于 0.4%；每笔争议收 15 美元

note.en: payouts go only through Stripe Connect Express, which does not reach mainland China
note.zh: 只能通过 Stripe Connect Express 出款，不支持中国大陆

fee.zh: 3.9% + 50 美分，没有国际和订阅附加费。

payout.en: after about 10 business days; 1% (minimum US$10); to mainland China, Hong Kong, the US, Japan, Korea and Singapore only
payout.zh: 约 10 个工作日后出款；手续费 1%（最低 10 美元）；只能提现到中国大陆、香港、美国、日本、韩国和新加坡

en: Also takes WeChat Pay for one-time orders in USD or CNY.
zh: 一次性订单还能用微信支付付款（美元或人民币）。

note.en: payouts to a bank card or Alipay in mainland China
note.zh: 提现到中国大陆的银行卡或支付宝

fee.en: 10% + 50¢ plus card processing 2.9% + 30¢; sales that come from Gumroad Discover pay 30%.
fee.zh: 10% + 50 美分，另加刷卡费 2.9% + 30 美分；来自 Gumroad Discover 的订单抽 30%。

payout.en: to a bank account, or PayPal where banks are not supported
payout.zh: 打到银行账户；银行不支持的地区走 PayPal

review_time.en: no website review: Gumroad hosts the product page
review_time.zh: 不审网站：商品页由 Gumroad 托管

en: A Merchant of Record since 2025; its prohibited list was not checked for this tool, so its category stances read as not addressed.
zh: 2025 年起是 MoR；这个工具没核对它的禁售清单，所以类目一栏都显示「政策没提」。

note.en: payouts to mainland China only through PayPal
note.zh: 提现到中国大陆只能走 PayPal

category_note.en: Dodo and Polar review AI content generation tools (text, image, video, voice); Creem lists generative AI products as restricted, with image and video tools as its examples; Waffo Pancake takes AI-generated content after an extra review if the content says it is AI-generated; Paddle restricts only face, likeness and voice-impersonation generation, and Lemon Squeezy bans NSFW chatbots
category_note.zh: Dodo 和 Polar 对 AI 内容生成工具（文本、图片、视频、语音）要人工审核；Creem 把生成式 AI 产品列为受限，举的例子是图片和视频工具；Waffo Pancake 接受 AI 生成内容，但要额外审核并标明内容由 AI 生成；Paddle 只限制人脸、肖像和声音冒充类生成，Lemon Squeezy 禁止色情聊天机器人

en: AI image and video products follow Creem's AI wrapper rules: https://docs.creem.io/merchant-of-record/account-reviews/ai-wrapper-compliance
zh: AI 图片和视频产品还要满足 Creem 的 AI 套壳规则：https://docs.creem.io/merchant-of-record/account-reviews/ai-wrapper-compliance

en: AI image and video products follow Waffo Pancake's AIGC rules: https://docs.waffo.ai/mor/account-reviews/aigc-compliance
zh: AI 图片和视频产品还要满足 Waffo Pancake 的 AIGC 规则：https://docs.waffo.ai/mor/account-reviews/aigc-compliance

category_note.en: Dodo and Polar review AI content generation tools (text, image, video, voice); Creem lists generative AI products as restricted, with image and video tools as its examples; Waffo Pancake takes AI-generated content after an extra review if the content says it is AI-generated; Paddle restricts only face, likeness and voice-impersonation generation, and Lemon Squeezy bans NSFW chatbots
category_note.zh: Dodo 和 Polar 对 AI 内容生成工具（文本、图片、视频、语音）要人工审核；Creem 把生成式 AI 产品列为受限，举的例子是图片和视频工具；Waffo Pancake 接受 AI 生成内容，但要额外审核并标明内容由 AI 生成；Paddle 只限制人脸、肖像和声音冒充类生成，Lemon Squeezy 禁止色情聊天机器人

en: AI image and video products follow Creem's AI wrapper rules: https://docs.creem.io/merchant-of-record/account-reviews/ai-wrapper-compliance
zh: AI 图片和视频产品还要满足 Creem 的 AI 套壳规则：https://docs.creem.io/merchant-of-record/account-reviews/ai-wrapper-compliance

en: AI image and video products follow Waffo Pancake's AIGC rules: https://docs.waffo.ai/mor/account-reviews/aigc-compliance
zh: AI 图片和视频产品还要满足 Waffo Pancake 的 AIGC 规则：https://docs.waffo.ai/mor/account-reviews/aigc-compliance

category_note.en: Paddle restricts realistic human-face generation; Creem wants its moderation running in production; Waffo Pancake wants the real model names and a moderation workflow published
category_note.zh: Paddle 限制逼真人脸生成；Creem 要求审核接口在生产环境运行；Waffo Pancake 要求公开写明实际模型和审核流程

category_note.en: Dodo bans thin AI-generated PDFs and reviews other e-books
category_note.zh: Dodo 禁止 AI 批量生成的低价值 PDF，其他电子书要审核

caveat.en: Counted from public checkout links found in backlink data, sellers worldwide. Checkouts a page opens with a script (Paddle.js, Stripe Checkout sessions) leave no link, so Paddle and embedded Stripe are undercounted; Gumroad and Stripe Payment Links are overcounted for the same reason.
caveat.zh: 数据来自外链里公开出现的收款链接，全球卖家；页面用脚本打开的结账（Paddle.js、Stripe Checkout）不留链接，所以 Paddle 和嵌入式 Stripe 被低估，Gumroad 和 Stripe 收款链接相对被高估。
